visualCharacteristics.purpose: page-top banner with a full-bleed photo and the heading, short copy and CTA either in a white box on the photo or laid directly over it

contentPattern.structure: one picture-only cell or row for the background photo; one copy cell (optional eyebrow, heading, text, CTA links). Further text cells are appended to the copy. Text colour on the photo follows the section style (dark, blue)

usage: Use as the top banner of feature, campaign and small-business pages. Default boxes centred copy in a white panel on the left of the photo; centred-heading-only centres a heading and line of text straight on the image (put it in a dark or blue section for light text); gradient-overlay fades the photo behind the box; text-on-photo lays left-aligned copy and CTAs directly on a light photo.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any photo banner without a product image. Use hero-chevron when the photo sits beside the copy and hero-card for credit-card offers.
